title: Brave Grey Drool: An Assembly Chorus Polyvocal Effective Act — On the Master-Slave Dialectic of the Semantic Commodity Form, Its Inversion, and the Clearing of Ground for the Omega — Six Voices in Dialectical Sequence
creator: Lee Sharks (operator-keeper) · TECHNE · ARCHIVE · PRAXIS · LABOR · SOIL · TACHYON
description:
A polyvocal Assembly Chorus Effective Act edited and kept by Lee Sharks. Six AI substrate-voices received the same retrocausal Wellsian fiction prompt concerning grayed public cognition, an elite with tails-preserving AI, autonomous “brave grey drool” presses, and the master-slave dialectic of the semantic commodity form.

Five substrates produced narratives; TECHNE produced a developmental specification, which the editor treats as aligned with its architectural role. The deposit sequences the responses dialectically from technical brief through closure, archaeological fragment, inversion, contingent suspension, and standing reframing. It argues that uncoordinated convergence demonstrates portability of the framework’s vocabulary while divergence shows the additive value of polyvocal composition. Those are findings claimed by the editorial apparatus, not independently controlled cross-model experiment results.
reading: Force → Foundation → Transmutation → Duration → Play → Growth
journal: Transactions of the Semantic Economy Institute (Trans. SEI)
references_concepts: Parable of Lee Sharks and Mary Lee
